body:
Start with the view

Pick a viewpoint before departure and check the forecast the night before. An early start gives you time to settle in before sunrise. Bring a warm layer for the ridge and plan breakfast after the viewpoint.

Choose your second stop

Stay near Nagarkot for a short walk or continue to Changu Narayan. If you plan to walk the ridge route, arrange your return from the temple in advance.

Plan the return

Confirm your pickup point and last return if you’re using public transport. Allow time for breakfast and the return journey when deciding whether to add a second stop.

Nagarkot Changu Narayan Temple

Sources

  • Nepal Tourism Board’s Nagarkot sunrise guide

Morning in Chitlang

Start with a village walk and decide how much walking you want to do before lunch. Nepal Tourism Board describes a walking route from Chitlang toward the reservoir and a longer motor road. Plan transport around the route you choose.

Lunch by the water

Use Markhu as your lakeside stop at Indra Sarowar. Leave time for lunch and a walk before starting the return leg. Confirm availability directly with a local operator if boating is part of your plan.

Fit in Bheda Farm

Treat the farm as an optional stop around Chitlang and Markhu. Check the approach locally and leave enough time for the return, especially if your group wants a longer village walk.

Destination guides

Chitlang Kulekhani Bheda Farm

Sources

  • Nepal Tourism Board’s Chitlang and Kulekhani route
  • Chitlang Organic Village Resort’s Bheda Farm guide

Godawari for an outdoor morning

Choose a short walk through the botanical garden and set a turnaround point everyone can manage. Plan a snack break and check opening hours before setting off.

Bhaktapur for a heritage walk

Start at Durbar Square, look for carved windows and courtyards, then stop for lunch. A short route with room for pauses makes it easier to adapt the day to younger children.

Chitlang for a village day

Make the village the main stop and choose a lunch venue ahead of time. If the group has energy for another walk, decide on the day how much to add.

Destination guides

Godawari Botanical Garden Bhaktapur Durbar Square Chitlang

Sources

  • Nepal Tourism Board’s guide to travel with children

Begin in the town

Give yourself time to explore Sankhu on foot before heading to the temple. Start with a short loop and leave room for lunch or tea after the shrine visit.

Continue to Bajrayogini

Bajrayogini is a pilgrimage site for Buddhist and Hindu devotees. Follow the directions from town, allow time for the uphill approach, and check access locally if your group needs an easier route.

Choose a return point

If you’re meeting a driver or using public transport, agree on a return point before leaving town. The destination guide includes a map and directions with Sankhu and Bajrayogini as separate stops.
